title: 第9章 搭救王翠第10章 吃醋了
content_zh:
;;
朱丽娜很主动。
“丽娜……丽娜……”
远处传来朱长发和媳妇刘凤英的声音。
夫妻俩一边喊，一边朝苞米地这边赶。
朱丽娜蹙着眉头。
“傻楚，现在看来是不行了，晚上你进我屋，我给你。”
她快速穿好衣服，从苞米地另外一头钻了出去。
等朱长发和刘凤英赶到苞米地，只陈楚一人在铲地。
“丽娜来了吗？”
“没来。”陈楚心想朱长发，你够可以的，给了彩礼，管的还这么紧。
不过你看得住白天，还看得住晚上么？
今天晚上就和朱丽娜入洞房。
这时候，电话响了。
“喂，你好。”
对面传来银铃般的笑声。
“陈先生，和我还这么客气啊？”
“诗逸，是你啊。”
“没错，给你打电话，想问问，你们村有没有绿色蔬菜？我的酒店需要一些。”
“有的，不过价格很高哦。”

“咯咯咯，你送吧，肯定不能亏待你呢。”
唐氏酒店现在由唐诗逸全权管理。
陈楚想到：普通蔬菜值不了什么钱，但把蔬菜灌输真气，价格便不一样了。
蔬菜村里人家家都有，但王寡妇一个人过得不容易，不如去她那里买些菜灌入真气去卖。
刚到王寡妇家门口。
就听见里面传来呼救声。
“救命啊……李长贵，你不是个人……”
王翠是十里八村有名的俏寡妇。
不过天妒红颜。
刚过门丈夫就死了。
村里人说是爽死的。
但是王翠知道，丈夫还没爽就死了。
只因为她太漂亮了。
村里人还说她是白虎精，克夫。
content_en:

Juliena is very proactive.
"Lina...Lina..."
The voices of Zhu Changfa and his wife Liu Fengying were heard in the distance.
The couple shouted and rushed towards Baomi Di.
Julina frowned.
"Sichu, it seems that it is no longer possible. If you come into my house at night, I will give it to you."
She quickly put on her clothes and got out from the other side of the corn field.
When Zhu Changfa and Liu Fengying arrived at the cornfield, Chen Chu was the only one shoveling the ground.
"Is Lina here?"
"Didn't come." Chen Chu thought to Zhu Changfa, you are capable enough, you gave the gift, but you are still so tight.
But if you can see it during the day, can you still see it at night?
We will enter the bridal chamber with Zhulina tonight.
At this time, the phone rang.
"Hi, hello."
A silver bell-like laughter came from the other side.
"Mr. Chen, are you still so polite to me?"
"Shiyi, it's you."
"That's right, I'm calling you to ask if there are any green vegetables in your village? My hotel needs some."
"Yes, but the price is very high."
"Keke, just give it away. I won't treat you badly."
Tang's Hotel is now fully managed by Tang Shiyi.
Chen Chu thought: Ordinary vegetables are not worth much, but if the vegetables are infused with Qi, the price will be different.
Everyone in the vegetable village has them, but Widow Wang has a hard time living alone, so why not go to her place to buy some vegetables and pour her energy into them to sell.
Just arrived at the door of Widow Wang’s house.
I heard calls for help coming from inside.
"Help... Li Changgui, you are not a human being..."
Wang Cui is a famous pretty widow in eight villages across ten miles.
But God is jealous of beauty.
My husband died just after I got home.
People in the village said it was very enjoyable.
But Wang Cui knew that her husband died before he was happy.
Just because she is so beautiful.
The people in the village also said that she was the white tiger spirit, Ke Fu.
